title: Payment API 500 Errors
description: Payment requests started returning HTTP 500 errors after a deployment
root_cause: Database connection pool was exhausted
resolution: Increased connection pool size and restarted the service

title: Slow Database Queries
description: Application database queries became extremely slow during peak traffic
root_cause: Missing indexes on frequently queried columns
resolution: Added indexes and optimized slow queries

title: Authentication Failure
description: Users were unable to log in after a new application release
root_cause: Incorrect authentication environment variables
resolution: Corrected environment variables and redeployed

title: API Timeout
description: Customer API requests were timing out intermittently
root_cause: Database queries were taking too long
resolution: Optimized queries and increased API timeout temporarily

title: Deployment Failure
description: Production deployment failed during dependency installation
root_cause: Incompatible package version
resolution: Updated dependency versions and rebuilt the deployment

title: Memory Usage High
description: Application memory usage continuously increased over several hours
root_cause: Memory leak in background processing task
resolution: Fixed object cleanup and restarted workers

title: Database Connection Error
description: Application could not connect to the production database
root_cause: Incorrect database credentials
resolution: Updated database credentials in environment configuration

title: Login API Error
description: Login endpoint returned errors for many users
root_cause: Expired authentication configuration
resolution: Updated authentication configuration and restarted API

title: Server CPU High
description: Server CPU reached very high utilization after traffic increased
root_cause: Unoptimized background processing job
resolution: Optimized the processing job and distributed workload

title: Order API Failure
description: Order creation failed with server errors after deployment
root_cause: Incorrect database migration
resolution: Applied missing migration and restarted the API

title: Payment Timeout
description: Payment requests were taking more than thirty seconds
root_cause: Slow database transaction during payment processing
resolution: Optimized transaction and database query

title: API Authentication Error
description: API requests were rejected after deployment
root_cause: Invalid API authentication configuration
resolution: Corrected API configuration and redeployed

title: Service Unavailable
description: Application returned 503 errors during deployment
root_cause: Application instances were not started correctly
resolution: Fixed deployment configuration and restarted instances

title: Database Disk Full
description: Database stopped accepting new records
root_cause: Database storage reached capacity
resolution: Cleaned old logs and increased storage capacity

title: Background Job Failure
description: Scheduled background jobs stopped running
root_cause: Worker process crashed because of an unhandled exception
resolution: Fixed exception handling and restarted workers

title: Product API Slow
description: Product API response time increased significantly
root_cause: Expensive database query was executed for every request
resolution: Optimized query and added caching

title: User Registration Failure
description: New users could not register successfully
root_cause: Database validation error was introduced during deployment
resolution: Fixed validation logic and redeployed

title: Database Deadlock
description: Several transactions failed because of database deadlocks
root_cause: Multiple transactions were updating the same records
resolution: Changed transaction order and optimized locking

title: Token Expiration Issue
description: Users were logged out unexpectedly after application update
root_cause: Incorrect token expiration configuration
resolution: Corrected token expiration settings

title: API Rate Limit Error
description: Legitimate API requests were rejected unexpectedly
root_cause: Rate limit configuration was too restrictive
resolution: Adjusted rate limit configuration
